cases.scope: One finite eager first-field chain of 1..3 distinct movable objects with immediate tail fields, populations 2..4. Full copy precedes each export; eager marking can discover/reserve/copy/publish the next object while other workers claim disjoint tails. Producer0 cannot claim scan work until its mark_array call returns. Counted producer activity spans the entire chain. Independent proposed-fault controls deactivate it at export or enter weak phase before strong closure. Positive is sequentially consistent finite safety/progress with atomic queue claims and abstract count/wake operations; it is not a C/POSIX wait proof. Delegates single-object eager/tail partition and general abstract GC work closure to composed contracts. Excludes aliasing/cycles, tail-reference discoveries, CAS losers, allocation failure, multiple eager producers, still/weak/continuation objects, arbitrary cardinalities, phase/heap-address reuse, C weak memory, actual wait signaling and native acceptance. No repeated vector-body scan diagnosis or runtime repair is claimed.
